actions.text: Warn villages and forest committees: no burning of leaves or fields, no fire in the forest.
Add a patrol to the places listed, in the morning.
Keep a crew and a vehicle ready in the area all day.

label: a fire detection inside forest on the next day (new or continuing)
note: A chance that a fire is detected in the area tomorrow (new or continuing), from a model checked on 2024 and 2025. It does not say where inside the area, how big, or how long. Fires already burning come from satellite detections.
